applicability: Every anchor observation the knowledge read's anchor resolver produces against a requested code tree (knowledge read pages, diff observations, the family roster).
conditions: The requested tree holds the exact recorded blob at the recorded path.
Symbol extents come from the shipped extractor for a language it has a grammar for.
exclusions: Observations whose resolution is not exact_recorded_blob, which carry no range.
Re-anchoring, searching or clipping a recorded range.
statement: The anchor resolver reports the line ranges an exact recorded blob supports as structured values -- every defining extent for a symbol locator, the recorded range for a line_range locator, none for a file locator -- and reports no range beside any other resolution, with its diagnostic sentence unchanged.
